title: Calendar addresses now drive mileage
details: Every learner booking with a visit address in the Milos calendar can now contribute to mileage, including Meeting bookings
The address saved on the calendar booking is now the source of truth for mileage and route planning
Learner profile site addresses remain useful as defaults when creating a booking but no longer override or supply mileage afterwards
The mileage PDF uses the same calendar addresses and now labels Meeting bookings correctly
Existing calendar bookings already containing an address are included when mileage is recalculated; the learner profile does not need an address
